title: Claude Code Tips and Tricks: 20 Things Power Users Do Differently
summary: Most Claude Code users tap 20% of its power. These 20 tips — from worktrees to hooks to dynamic workflows — are what separates power users from beginners.
body_markdown: CLAUDE.md is a project-specific context file Claude reads at the start of every session. When you correct Claude on something — a wrong convention, a missed edge case, a bad pattern — ending with "Update your CLAUDE.md so you don't make that mistake again" permanently captures that lesson. Anthropic calls this "Compounding Engineering": every correction improves every future session. Most developers re-explain the same things session after session instead of writing them down once.
